name: Ningyohime
source: A beautiful girl who values others' happiness more than her own and works hard to make sure the people around her happy. Though she has both a gentle personality and way of speaking, Ningyohime has a stubborn side to her as well. She is madly in love with [url=/c68683]Tsuu[/url] who told Ningyohime she'll be her "prince" when they were younger.
